name: add_home_widget
description: Add or remove a live widget on the Jarvis home screen dashboard. Widget types: 'tv' = TV remote, 'printer' = 3D printer status, 'weather-home' = current weather, 'ha-device' = Home Assistant device controls.

parameters.description: Use 'add' to show a widget on the home screen. Use 'remove' to close/hide it.
Which widget. 'tv' = TV remote control panel. 'printer' = 3D printer live status. 'weather-home' = current weather. 'ha-device' = Home Assistant device controls.
Optional custom title for the widget header, e.g. 'Living Room TV', 'X1 Carbon'.
For widget_type='printer': the printer name to show, e.g. 'X1 Carbon'. Omit to show all printers.
For widget_type='ha-device': HA domain to filter devices, e.g. 'light', 'switch', 'climate'.
For widget_type='ha-device': fuzzy name filter for devices, e.g. 'bedroom', 'kitchen'.
